name: Faraday Future FF Faber U
summary: A 185 kg two-armed robot with a head on a wheeled base, height 1.2 to 1.7 m, 5 kg per arm, dual 3D LiDAR and Jetson Thor compute, for factory and logistics handling.

germany.statusNote: No authorised route into the EU found: FF sells Faber U through US contact sales; a US-run web shop (Roboter Deutschland) lists it for quotation only, no price, "allow 2-4 weeks for delivery".

specs.label: Compute
specs.value: NVIDIA Jetson Thor T5000, up to 2070 TOPS (500–2070 TOPS)

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: Dual 3D LiDAR, 2 RGB-D, 3 fisheye and 7 stereo cameras

specs.label: Development
specs.value: Ubuntu 22.04 + ROS, open SDK / API, OTA updates

notes: Two arms and a head on a wheeled base (FF calls the series mobile manipulators); wheeled, so no stairs.
Photos show five-finger hands; the Faber U spec panel names no end effector and the series has interchangeable end effectors.
The reseller spec table gives 88.5 kg, 35 DoF and 15 kg per arm for Faber U; on the FF page those figures sit under the Faber T tab.

images.alt: FF Faber U wheeled two-arm robot, three-quarter view

evidence.task: Machine tending: part picking, assembly and transfer
evidence.note: Series-level claim; FF names its own factory line as proof, model not stated.

evidence.task: Goods recognition, sorting and handling in warehouses

openQuestions: Which spec set is Faber U? FF page markup mixes tab labels and panel ids; image file names and the FF menu photo match the 185 kg Thor version used here.
